kjv: Lest thou shouldest ponder the path of life ... thou canst not know
mine: she (the forbidden woman) does not keep to the path of life ... she does not know it
note: Hebrew tephalles and teda' can be 2nd masc. ("you") or 3rd fem. ("she"); context about her ways favours "she".

kjv: Let thy fountains be dispersed abroad
mine: Should your springs be scattered abroad?
note: Hebrew yaphutsu is best read as a rhetorical question (answered by v. 17 "let them be yours alone"); the KJV's wish says the opposite of the passage's point.
